name: Debra Verrall
title: She makes it so easy to get results!
text: I was new to Skool and knew I needed to start building an email list when I came across Kylie. I started with the Breaking up with IG mini course and loved her nurturing style of delivery. Breaking down each step into manageable pieces was just what I needed to not feel overwhelmed and got me the result I was looking for. An IG 'store front' that lets visitors know exactly what I do, without having to post every day - such a relief!
